Since then, whether it is the stormy rain in Sichuan or the gentle rain in Jiangnan, he was reproduced in the painting, fascinating, so commentators often use "half of the mountains and rivers with rain" to describe the characteristics of its paintings. When it comes to painting rain, he believes that ancient painters "do not paint rain directly, but can make people feel the rain. ...... came to Jin Dongxin in the Qing Dynasty, who began to explore the method of painting rain directly. I have been influenced by him and absorbed the expression method of Western watercolor painting. However, the most important teacher for me is nature itself." Nature triggered his inspiration, to provide him with material, in the absorption of the strengths of Chinese and foreign painting rain skills on the basis of Fu Baoshi successful performance originally no fixed shape of rain momentum, the formation of a strong infection, can be called a masterpiece.　　From the picture inscription can be seen in this picture is the painter in the central university viewing jin nong painted "wind and rain return to the boat" when the inspiration, and after repeated deliberation, before the pen, its prudent attitude can be seen. The boatman swings the oar with all his strength, while the owner holds up an umbrella to avoid the pouring rain. The reeds on the shore were broken by the wind, and the mountains in the distance were blurred by the wind and rain into a misty patch. The realistic effect of wind and rain makes people feel like they are in the middle of it, as if they can hear the sound of wind, rain, water and thunder intertwined in a symphony, which swells the heart.　　This picture was donated by Fu Baoshi's wife, Luo Shihui.
